spec_dod.text: A record whose `trace_id` matches the declared schema passes `logs-pipeline`'s validation stage unchanged.
A record missing `trace_id` entirely is routed to the dead-letter output, never the accepted stream.
When the reject ratio for a batch exceeds 10%, `logs-pipeline` halts the batch and raises an alert instead of continuing to process it.
Records that pass validation retain every original field byte-for-byte in the accepted-stream output (no silent field coercion).
The dead-letter alert's phrasing gives an on-call engineer enough context to act without digging.

question: Derive which of the raw recordings bear on each DoD criterion (ignore any that bear on none), classify each met / unmet / needs-human, and force every `prose` criterion to needs-human.
